product_title: Handcrafted Pink Floral Tealight Holder Set
product_description: A beautiful handcrafted set featuring vibrant pink roses, delicate pearl accents, mirror detailing, and golden tealight holders. Perfect for Diwali, pooja decor, and festive table styling.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water and harsh chemicals.
Protect flowers and embellishments from direct heat.
Use on a stable, heat-resistant surface and never leave a lit candle unattended.
Store in a dry, protective box when not in use.
